_source: initializeResult, modes and availableCommands are copied from docs/spikes/S9/01-initialize.jsonl and 02-session-new.jsonl (Hermes 0.17.0). availableCommands keeps the five commands K9 advertises (help, model, steer, queue, version) with Hermes's own descriptions and hints. helpText and versionText are Hermes's verbatim answers (S9.md); their sha256 equals the redacted[0].sha256 of 05-prompt-help.jsonl and 06-prompt-version.jsonl. sdk holds messages serialized by Hermes's own ACP SDK (acp.utils.serialize_params on acp_adapter.permissions, edit_approval and tools builders, 2026-11-23) for the shapes S9 did not record.

helpText:
Available commands:

  /help        Show available commands
  /model       Show or change current model
  /tools       List available tools
  /context     Show conversation context info
  /reset       Clear conversation history
  /compact     Compress conversation context
  /steer       Inject guidance into the currently running agent turn
  /queue       Queue a prompt to run after the current turn finishes
  /version     Show Hermes version

Unrecognized /commands are sent to the model as normal messages.
